name: com.brydge-ai/brydge
title: BRYDGE
description: Checks whether an agent's actions actually happened, against the destination's own records.

environmentVariables.name: BRYDGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your BRYDGE API key. It starts with brydge_sk_; issue one in BRYDGE on the Connect page.

environmentVariables.name: BRYDGE_ACTOR
environmentVariables.description: The name BRYDGE knows this agent by, such as agent:refund-ops. Mandates are issued to this name.

environmentVariables.name: BRYDGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Where BRYDGE runs. Leave it unset for BRYDGE's hosted service.
